description: Firestore sync improvements (TASK 5A+5B+5C): Remove manual sync button from SettingsDialog, fix Firestore batch limit (chunked(400)), add sync for wallets/cash_box_entries/products/invoices/nominees. Independent of FEAT-001 at the Firestore layer but depends on upsertWallet/upsertCashBoxEntry/upsertProduct/upsertNominee stubs added in FEAT-001 step 4.
steps: 1. Remove manual sync button from SettingsDialog (app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/components/SettingsDialog.kt): Delete the entire '// ── Phase 5: Sync section ──' block (the section header Text, status Text, and OutlinedButton 'এখনই সিঙ্ক করুন'). Remove `onManualSync: () -> Unit = {}` parameter from the SettingsDialog function signature. Keep syncStatus parameter display if used elsewhere, otherwise remove it too. IMPORTANT: do not break any other parameters or sections.

2. Fix the SettingsDialog call site in MainAppContent (app/src/main/java/com/example/MainActivity.kt): Remove the `onManualSync = { viewModel.triggerManualSync() }` and `syncStatus = syncStatus` arguments from the SettingsDialog(...) call. Also remove `val syncStatus by viewModel.syncStatus.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()` if it is only used for the manual sync UI (confirm it is not used elsewhere in MainAppContent first — it IS used for backupStatus display elsewhere, so check carefully before removing the collectAsStateWithLifecycle call).

3. Fix Firestore batch limit in SyncManager.pushAllToFirestore() (app/src/main/java/com/example/data/cloud/SyncManager.kt): Replace `transactions.take(400).forEach { tx -> batch.set(...) }` with a chunked loop: `transactions.chunked(400).forEach { chunk -> val batchChunk = db.batch(); chunk.forEach { tx -> batchChunk.set(txCollection.document(tx.id.toString()), data) }; batchChunk.commit().await() }`. Move `_syncStatus.value = SyncStatus.SYNCED` after all chunks complete.

4. Add pushPartiesToFirestore() to SyncManager (app/src/main/java/com/example/data/cloud/SyncManager.kt): Similar to pushAllToFirestore but for parties collection. Use chunked(400). Party data map: id, name, phone, partyType, currentAmount, updatedAt, note, modifiedAt=System.currentTimeMillis().

5. Add push methods for wallets, cash_box_entries, products, invoices, nominees to SyncManager (app/src/main/java/com/example/data/cloud/SyncManager.kt): For each collection, add `suspend fun push{Collection}ToFirestore()` method using chunked(400) pattern. Wallet map: id, name, balance, type, modifiedAt. CashBoxEntry map: id, type, amount, note, dateMillis, reconciledDate, modifiedAt. Product map: id, name, stock, buyPrice, sellPrice, expiryDate, category, createdAt, modifiedAt. Invoice map: id, invoiceNumber, customerName, customerPhone, totalAmount, dateMillis, note, modifiedAt. Nominee map: id, name, relation, phone, email, accessScope, canViewCash, note, modifiedAt. Add COLLECTION_* constants for each.

6. Add snapshot listeners for wallets in startSync() (app/src/main/java/com/example/data/cloud/SyncManager.kt): After existing transactionListener and partyListener, add walletListener that calls processWalletSnapshot(). processWalletSnapshot() merges by modifiedAt using repository.upsertWallet(). Follow same ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED pattern as processTransactionSnapshot().

7. Add isDeleted field to transaction Firestore maps in SyncManager (app/src/main/java/com/example/data/cloud/SyncManager.kt): In pushAllToFirestore() data map, add `'isDeleted' to tx.isDeleted` and `'deletedAt' to tx.deletedAt`. In processTransactionSnapshot(), on ADDED/MODIFIED: if doc.getBoolean('isDeleted') == true, call repository softDeleteById (if not already deleted locally) rather than upsert. On REMOVED: if isDeleted locally, no-op; otherwise soft-delete.

8. Update pushAllToFirestore() call in MainViewModel to call the new push methods (app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/viewmodel/MainViewModel.kt): In triggerManualSync() (keep the function — just remove the UI entry point, not the function itself), after pushAllToFirestore(), also call pushPartiesToFirestore(), pushWalletsToFirestore(), etc. These are called automatically by auto-sync. The auto-sync on sign-in path calls startSync() which uses listeners; the push methods are used for initial data upload.
acceptance_criteria: SettingsDialog no longer has 'এখনই সিঙ্ক করুন' button
SettingsDialog.onManualSync parameter is removed (no unused parameter warning)
pushAllToFirestore() uses chunked(400) and does not fail for >400 transactions
SyncManager has push methods for all 5 new collections (wallets, cash_box_entries, products, invoices, nominees)
Transaction Firestore maps include isDeleted and deletedAt fields

Removed `onManualSync: () -> Unit = {}` and `syncStatus: SyncStatus = SyncStatus.IDLE` parameters from the function signature. 2. MainActivity: removed `val syncStatus by viewModel.syncStatus.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()` (confirmed only used at SettingsDialog call site), and removed `onManualSync = { viewModel.triggerManualSync() }` and `syncStatus = syncStatus` arguments from the SettingsDialog(...) call. 3. SyncManager.pushAllToFirestore(): replaced transactions.take(400).forEach with chunked(400) loop creating a new db.batch() per chunk; moved _syncStatus.value = SyncStatus.SYNCED after all chunks complete. Added 'isDeleted' and 'deletedAt' to transaction data map. 4. pushPartiesToFirestore() added with chunked(400). 5.
